templates.name: minimalist
templates.label: Minimalist
templates.description: Clean white canvas, single blue accent, lots of whitespace. Default fallback when the topic doesn't hint at a specific style.

templates.name: corporate
templates.label: Corporate
templates.description: Structured business deck with header bar, accent rule, and footer metadata.

templates.name: pitch-deck
templates.label: Pitch Deck
templates.description: Linear/Vercel-style dark canvas, orange-to-amber gradient metric numbers, glowing dot accents. High-contrast and confident.

templates.name: academic
templates.label: Academic
templates.description: Scholarly journal aesthetic — IBM Plex Serif headlines, footnote-style numbered bullets, deep-red accent. Generous margins.

templates.name: playful
templates.label: Playful
templates.description: Dark Linear-style canvas with multi-color radial accents, rounded badges with emoji, big bouncy Nunito display. Built for creator content.

templates.name: editorial
templates.label: Editorial
templates.description: Magazine-spread aesthetic — NYT/New Yorker register. Cream paper, vermillion accent, Fraunces serif, running-head folio bar, italic pull-quotes with giant opening quotation mark.

templates.name: retro
templates.label: Retro (80s)
templates.description: Synthwave neon. Magenta-purple gradient canvas with cyan/pink accents, VT323 display font, CRT scanlines, neon-glow text shadow on titles.

templates.name: tech
templates.label: Tech / Terminal
templates.description: IDE-aesthetic deck. Dark zinc canvas, terminal-green prompt accents, JetBrains Mono everywhere, macOS traffic-light dots + shell-prompt chrome. Built for engineering audiences.

templates.name: zen
templates.label: Zen
templates.description: Japanese minimalism. Washi-paper canvas, sumi-black ink, 朱印 vermillion accent. Generous asymmetric padding (yohaku-no-bi 余白の美), Noto Serif JP display, vertical accent dividers.

templates.name: warm
templates.label: Warm Paper
templates.description: Vintage kraft notebook. Cream-tan gradient with SVG paper grain, cocoa ink, burnt-orange accent. EB Garamond body + Caveat handwritten kickers, hand-drawn underline rules. Built for hand-made feel.
